thread:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we surfaced ~18 items from the launch window. Propose a lightweight "FixWave" vs "Polish Wave" split and owners. Goal: lock triage in 24h.

maya (PM): FixWave = regressions/security/data-loss/blockers (72h SLA). Polish Wave = UX polish, non-blocking perf tuning, requested enhancements (2w).

devin (ENG): +1. can we get a severity + customer-impact score? Prefer simple 0-3 for each.

lina (SWE): I pulled the runbook into the sheet: https://go.redwood/triage-runbook (private). Added columns: severity, customers-affected, repro-ease, suggested owner.

terry (CS): FYI — three paid customers pinged about hallucination on embeddings route. Two of them are on Dedicated. Marking high customer-impact until we verify.

aj (SRE): We also had a small memory bump on model-prod-7 during peak. Not a crash, but inflight queue latency increased ~50ms. Could be config for KV cache size.

maya (PM): Proposed rubric (apply to each item): severity (0-none,1-minor,2-major,3-blocker); customer-impact (0-3); repro-ease (0-3). Sum >=6 => FixWave. Sum 4-5 => Reviewer call. Sum <=3 => Polish Wave. Thoughts?

devin (ENG): Works for me. Suggest we auto-flag anything tagged security or data-loss directly into FixWave.

lina (SWE): Agree. I'll tag the hallucination tickets with security? they look like model defect not exfiltration. Not security. I'll add labels: regression/customer-blocking.

triage-bot: New ticket imported: RB-4821 - embeddings hallucination (cust A). severity:2, customers:2, repro:1.

maya (PM): RB-4821 temp: Sum=5 -> reviewer call. @devin can you take initial look? @terry please collect customer repro samples.

devin (ENG): Taking RB-4821. I'll run local evals and check model variant used. If it's a prompt/few-shot mismatch we can push prompt guard in <24h.

aj (SRE): For the memory bump, tagging RB-4817. severity:1, customers:0, repro:3. Sum=4 -> reviewer call. I'll add traces.

maya (PM): Owners so far: RB-4821 -> devin + terry (owner), RB-4817 -> aj + lina (owner). I'll consolidate in the sheet and send the meeting invite only if reviewer call needed.

terry (CS): Two customers asked for SLA on Dedicated for this class of failures. We should note follow-on milestone: "Dedicated SLA docs update" — assign to product-ops.

maya (PM): Good call. Follow-on milestone list: 1) FixWave rollout + hotfix docs, 2) Dedicated SLA update, 3) Eval harness for embeddings (owner: research), 4) Mini A/B to test prompt guard. I'll add owners + target dates in the sheet.

devin (ENG): ETA for RB-4821 initial triage: 12h. If fix is a prompt guard, we can push a config flag to prod in a single patch. If it's model-level, we escalate.

lina (SWE): I'm adding test cases to regressions repo. Labeling what must be included in the 72h canary.

maya (PM): Decision checklist before promoting FixWave fixes: passed regen tests, no perf regression (latency < +10ms), canary to 5% for 2h, rollback plan documented.

devin (ENG): Note: for canary we might need to wire routing policy to avoid Dedicated customers seeing the canary. aj can help.

aj (SRE): Yep — will configure routing rules for canary and monitor token-level latency/cost.

maya (PM): Action items: - devin: triage RB-4821 (12h) - aj: tracing & canary routing (today) - lina: regression tests + labels (today) - terry: collect customer repros and expectation notes (12h) - maya: consolidate sheet + update triage doc (EOD)

terry (CS): I'll draft customer-facing note for the two Dedicated customers after devin confirms root cause.

devin (ENG): On it. Will post short repro summary in this thread (or RB ticket) when I have it.

maya (PM): Thanks all. If no objections, I'll mark this thread as the source-of-truth for FixWave allocations and update the sprint board. :thumbsup:

lina (SWE): No objections.

aj (SRE): +1

triage-bot: Reminder: reviewer call scheduled if any ticket moves to 'reviewer' state by 2000006825.

maya (PM): Locking triage for now — will post final assignments in sheet by 2000006832.
